OnBoardingSlide1Desc: We know campus life can be exhausting. Here, you can take time to understand your feelings, thoughts, and needs without judgment.
OnBoardingSlide2Desc: This app is here as your mental health companion. From journaling to professional help access — all in one safe and private space.
OnBoardingSlide3Desc: It's time to give yourself some space. Begin your journey toward better mental health — one small step, one mindful moment at a time.
OnBoardingSlide4Desc: This is your safe space to feel, reflect, and grow. No need to be perfect — just be yourself, one step at a time.
